Thanks — next steps from our procurement/tax side: we need either a completed W-9 (if you’ll bill from a US entity) or a completed W-8BEN-E (if you’ll bill from a non-US entity). From the notes you gave on the call, W-8BEN-E sounds right.

Required items to enable a PO:
1) Signed W-8BEN-E PDF (scanned or DocuSign accepted)
2) A recent bank letter showing account name and address (pdf) for ACH
3) Evidence of authorized signer (bank letter, company letterhead or DocuSign envelope)

Notarization is NOT required for standard onboarding, but if your finance team prefers to notarize that’s fine; it doesn’t speed up the queue.

Please name attachments like: EgressSupply_W-8BEN-E_signed.pdf and EgressSupply_bank_letter_YYYY-MM.pdf.
